successors.name: Republic of Chile
successors.text: Easter Island (Rapa Nui), 163.6 km2 (Easter Island infobox)

ledger.x: 1200: the Polynesian chiefdom of Rapa Nui begins with the settlement of the island.
1888: the chiefs cede Rapa Nui's sovereignty to Chile.

wars.name: Peruvian slave raids
wars.outcome: 'More than 1400 Rapanui islanders were kidnapped, about half of the island's population'; the slaves were freed in autumn 1863 but most had died.

wars.name: Wars of the two confederations
wars.outcome: 'From 1724 until 1750, the 'Otu 'Itu fought the Tu'u for control of the island', continuing 'until the 1860s'; no division of the island is recorded.

certainty.note: A single island: the coast is the border.
